using System;
using System.Net.Http;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using Xunit;
using OpenRA.Mods.Common.Widgets.Logic;
using Moq;

namespace OpenRA.Mods.Common.Tests.Widgets.Logic
{
	public class ServerListLogicTests
	{
		[Fact]
		public void RefreshServerList_DoesNotStartQueryIfActiveQueryIsTrue()
		{
			// Arrange
			var modData = new TestModData();
			var logic = new ServerListLogic(new TestWidget(), modData, _ => { });
			// Set activeQuery to true via reflection since it's private
			var activeQueryField = typeof(ServerListLogic).GetField("activeQuery", System.Reflection.BindingFlags.NonPublic | System.Reflection.BindingFlags.Instance);
			activeQueryField.SetValue(logic, true);

			// Act
			logic.RefreshServerList();

			// Assert
			// Since activeQuery was true, RefreshServerList should return immediately and not change searchStatus
			var searchStatusField = typeof(ServerListLogic).GetField("searchStatus", System.Reflection.BindingFlags.NonPublic | System.Reflection.BindingFlags.Instance);
			var searchStatusValue = (Enum)searchStatusField.GetValue(logic);
			Assert.NotEqual(Enum.Parse(searchStatusField.FieldType, "Fetching"), searchStatusValue);
		}

		[Fact]
		public async Task RefreshServerList_StartsQueryAndCallsHttpClientGetAsync()
		{
			// This test is limited because HttpClientFactory.Create() is called inside the method and is not injectable.
			// We cannot mock HttpClient easily without refactoring the production code.
			// So this test will just call RefreshServerList and ensure no exceptions are thrown.
			var modData = new TestModData();
			var logic = new ServerListLogic(new TestWidget(), modData, _ => { });

			// Act & Assert
			// We cannot await RefreshServerList because it returns void and runs async Task internally.
			// So we just call it and wait a bit for the task to run.
			logic.RefreshServerList();
			await Task.Delay(1000);
		}

		// Minimal stub classes to satisfy constructor dependencies
		class TestWidget : OpenRA.Widgets.Widget
		{
			public override T Get<T>(string name) => default;
			public override T GetOrNull<T>(string name) => default;
		}

		class TestModData : OpenRA.ModData
		{
			public override T GetOrCreate<T>()
			{
				if (typeof(T) == typeof(OpenRA.Mods.Common.Widgets.Logic.WebServices))
					return (T)(object)new WebServices();
				return base.GetOrCreate<T>();
			}
		}

		class WebServices
		{
			public string ServerList => "http://localhost";
			public ModVersionStatus ModVersionStatus => ModVersionStatus.Latest;
		}

		enum ModVersionStatus
		{
			NotChecked,
			Latest,
			Outdated,
			Unknown,
			PlaytestAvailable
		}
	}
}
